item.title: Ontario Ranks Second Globally, Overtakes Saskatchewan in New Fraser Mining Survey

item.title: Oil, LNG Prices Climb on Fears of Prolonged Hormuz Shutdown
item.description: Oil and gas prices surged Monday (March 2) after fresh military strikes between the US, Israel, and Iran rattled energy markets and brought shipping through the Strait of Hormuz close to a halt, raising fears of a wider supply shock.Brent crude, the global oil benchmark, jumped as much as 10 percent to trade above US$82 per barrel before easing back toward US$79. item.title: Fortune Bay: Exploration Underway, Fully Funded Program at the Goldfields Project in Saskatchewan
